scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Cp, heat content, and y_va at selected hidden temperatures using the paper's own model and parameters, then compares agent's CSV values with appropriate tolerances. This avoids trusting a static gold and is feasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for Cp, H-H298, y_va at hidden temperatures
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Table 1 parameters and model equations (Eqs. 1-8)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed on-the-fly by the checker using the same model with the published parameters
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from published model; no external data or arbitrary numbers were invented

outputs.description: Isobaric heat capacity of bcc W including vacancy effects as a function of temperature. Compared against paper-derived reference values at selected temperatures with an appropriate tolerance.
Heat content (enthalpy increment) of bcc W relative to 298.15 K. Checked by comparing values at hidden temperatures against reference data.
Equilibrium thermal vacancy concentration in bcc W, computed from the model. Verified against paper-derived values at selected temperatures.

output_contract.notes: All three artifacts are produced by the same underlying model evaluation. The hidden checker extracts values at a small set of temperatures and compares them to pre-computed reference values from the paper's own model; tolerances account for numerical differences in root-finding and integration.

steps.description: Monotonic increase of Cp and H_minus_H298 with T; curvature in log10(y_va) vs 10000/T (non-zero second derivative).
